'''Verste''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Verste''' is a country in [[Quia]]. Located on the western edge of the continent, it covers the bulk of the [[Bay of Screti]]. It has a land area of about 1,193,527 km2 (460,823 sq mi), making it the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|thirty-third-largest country]] and the 10th-largest in Quia. It is bordered by the [[Doulu sea]] and [[Haanian Ocean]] to the west; [[Ahokini]], and [[Quidic]] to the north; [[Yihnurda]] to the east; and [[United Mihili]] to the southeast. Most of its terrain consists of [[wikipedia:Farm|farms]] and lowland, steppe, and mountains. The capital and largest city is [[Kiamlo]]; other major cities include [[Ralut]] and [[Zelvori]], the holiest city in ______. With a population of almost 53.3 million, Verste is the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|fifth most populous country]] on the continent.

Pre-Ast [[Stomelu]], the territory that constitutes modern-day Verste, was the site of several [[Ancient cultures in Stomelu|ancient cultures]] and civilizations; the prehistory of Verste shows some of the earliest traces of [[wikipedia:Early_human_migrations|human activity]] outside the [[Old Continent]]. ____ is one of the [[List of religious populations|world's largest religions]] and emerged in what is now Verste in the early fourth century. The First Ast [[Divendecum]] united the population of the [[Shorhi Peninsula]] and founded the city of [[Zelvori]] in honor of his daughter. [[Zelvori]] became a center of ___ learning. Much of [[Verstian architecture|Verste's architecture]] survived until modern times. For centuries, it was a primary producer of [[arcvania]], exported through the port of [[Mendri]]. Various dynasties emerged between the 9th and 16th centuries. During the 17th century, the country was divided between the [[Kuwana Dynasty|Ashaini]] and [[Emaran empire|Emaran empires]]. After the [[Red War]], a Republic was established and, in 1702, became the [[Democratic Republic of Verste]] following a coup. In 1723, the dictatorship collapsed, giving rise to the modern Republic of Verste, the first and only officially [[wikipedia:Socialist_state|socialist state]] on the continent.

Verste is considered both a regional and a [[wikipedia:Middle_power|middle power]]. Since [[wikipedia:Petroleum|petroleum]] was discovered in the country, the republic has become the [[List of countries by oil production|world's third-largest oil producer]] and third-leading oil exporter, controlling the world's s[[List of countries by oil production|econd-largest oil reserves]] and the [[List of countries by natural gas production|fourth-largest gas reserves]]. Verste is categorized as a [[Developing country|developing economy]] and is the only Geccean country among the world's [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|major economies]]. The Saudi economy is the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)| fourth-largest in the world]] and the world's [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|twenty-fifth-largest by nominal GDP]]. Ranking very high in the [[Krali Total Development Index]], Verste offers free [[wikipedia:University|university]] tuition, a low [[wikipedia:Personal_income|personal income tax]], and free [[wikipedia:Universal_health_care universal|health care]]. With its dependency on the [[oil industry]]. Verste has a notably young population, with approximately half of its residents under 30. This [[wikipedia:Demography|demographic]] trend is partly attributed to the tendency of older individuals to emigrate from the country upon retirement. Verste is a member of the [[Quian Union]], [[Global Development Bank]], and the [[Global Trade Union]]. It is a member of [[SDSA]], the [[Main 32]], [[LLO|LLID]] and [[H2ISQ]].
